Bill.BriefDescription: Adjusting regional transportation planning organization board membership.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to membership on regional transportation planningorganization boards; amending RCW 47.80.060; and adding a new sectionto chapter 47.80 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 47.80.060 and 1992 c 101 s 31 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: In order to qualify for state planning funds available to regionaltransportation planning organizations, the regional transportationplanning organizations containing any county with a population inexcess of one million shall provide voting membership on its executiveboard to the state transportation commission, the state department oftransportation, ((and)) the three largest public port districts withinthe region as determined by gross operating revenues, and any principalcity of a metropolitan statistical area within the region, in existenceon January 1, 2004, as designated by the United States Census Bureau.((It shall further assure that at least fifty percent of the county andcity local elected officials who serve on the executive board alsoserve on transit agency boards or on a regional transit authority.))

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 47.80 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Each regional transportation planning organization shall ensurethat the unincorporated areas within its region are appropriatelyrepresented on all organization boards, including its executive board.The regional transportation planning organization may determine how theunincorporated areas within its region are to be appropriatelyrepresented on its boards.
